cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EmailApp CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(ExternalProject)

set(DOTNET_PROJECT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/EmailValidatorAot")
set(DOTNET_RID "win-x64")
set(DOTNET_CONFIG "Release")

# Destination directory generated by dotnet publish
set(DOTNET_OUT_DIR "${DOTNET_PROJECT_DIR}/bin/${DOTNET_CONFIG}/net8.0/${DOTNET_RID}/publish")
set(DOTNET_LIB "${DOTNET_OUT_DIR}/EmailValidatorAot.lib")
set(DOTNET_DLL "${DOTNET_OUT_DIR}/EmailValidatorAot.dll")

# Build the C# Native AOT library
ExternalProject_Add(EmailValidatorAot_Build
    PREFIX              "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/EmailValidatorAot"
    SOURCE_DIR          "${DOTNET_PROJECT_DIR}"
    CONFIGURE_COMMAND   ""
    BUILD_COMMAND       dotnet publish "${DOTNET_PROJECT_DIR}/EmailValidatorAot.csproj"
                        -c ${DOTNET_CONFIG}
                        -r ${DOTNET_RID}
    INSTALL_COMMAND     ""
    BUILD_BYPRODUCTS    "${DOTNET_LIB}" "${DOTNET_DLL}"
)

# Imported library target
add_library(EmailValidatorAot SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
add_dependencies(EmailValidatorAot EmailValidatorAot_Build)
set_target_properties(EmailValidatorAot PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${DOTNET_DLL}"
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB   "${DOTNET_LIB}"
)

# C++ Executable
add_executable(EmailApp main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(EmailApp PRIVATE EmailValidatorAot)

# Copy the DLL next to the final executable
add_custom_command(TARGET EmailApp POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        "${DOTNET_DLL}"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:EmailApp>"
)
